name: Research Memory
description: Long-term research memory + orchestration for OpenClaw, backed by the openclaw-research-graph Python graph backend. Exposes research/query/walk tools and slash commands and owns the canonical graph store so Claude/Codex harnesses are positioned as low-level executors below it.

dbPath.description: Filesystem path for the research-graph JSON backend. Falls back to RESEARCH_GRAPH_DB env var or ./research_graph.json.

python.description: Python interpreter to use for subprocess bridging. Defaults to python3.

packageDir.description: Optional override for the research_graph package parent dir. Falls back to RESEARCH_GRAPH_PACKAGE_DIR env var or the plugin's repo root.
